calculate_binary_classification_metrics: calculate binary classification metrics including f1, precision, recall, auc, and accuracy from raw predictions
calculate_multi_class_classification_met: calculate multi-class classification metrics with macro, micro, and weighted averaging for f1, precision, and recall
create_model_card: create a model card for a text classification model with validation metrics and dataset tags
pause_huggingface_endpoint: pause a Hugging Face inference endpoint by sending an API request with a bearer token
review_classification_eval_metrics: review the binary and multi-class classification evaluation metric tuples used for text classification tasks
